title_en: Venus: A Day Longer Than Its Year
reveal_en: On Venus, a single rotation (a day) takes 243 Earth days to complete. However, its orbit around the Sun (a year) takes only 225 Earth days.
reveal_zh: 金星自转一周（一日）需耗时243个地球日，但它绕太阳公转一周（一年）却仅需225个地球日。
meaning_en: This peculiar planetary dynamic fundamentally redefines our intuitive sense of “day” and “year.”
meaning_zh: 这种独特的行星动力学颠覆了我们对“日”与“年”的固有认知。

visual.motion: Slow sphere rotation, rapid elliptical orbit.
